exposure: maternal occupation (practical nurse vs. secretary vs. housewife)
stressful work conditions such as shift work, prolonged standing and long working hours
exposure to chemical, physical and biological hazards
cohort: Singleton newborns in Finland born between 1997 and 2014
finding: Working as a practical nurse was associated with a lower likelihood of low birthweight, perinatal death, and SGA, but a higher likelihood of instrumental delivery.
mod_finding: Working as a practical nurse was significantly related to higher odds of instrumental delivery (OR=1.08; 95% CI: 1.00-1.17).
